subtasks: Pick up the key, hand it over to the other hand, insert it into the keyhole, then turn it.
Pick up the fallen silver key from the table with the left gripper, then hold it above the table for the handoff.
Hand the lifted key from the left gripper to the right gripper. Keep the left gripper closed until the right fingers have grasped the exposed key.

Keep the lifted silver key steady in the left gripper while the right gripper approaches the exposed part of the key and closes on it for a handoff. Keep the left gripper closed until the right grasp is secure.
